span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Light-driven VIP firing inhibits other interneurons, which releases a subset of pyramidal cells from inhibition — an excitation-inhibition-excitation sequence that is the signature of disinhibition.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Long-range or neuromodulatory inputs recruit VIP cells, and the resulting disinhibition selectively raises the gain of particular pyramidal ensembles.
span.note: status: the paper's own words: we propose that

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because the disinhibition lands preferentially on tone-selective neurons, relaying the reinforcement signal through VIP cells could implement cortical learning.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms

span.label: How far this circuit overlaps with the previously described layer 1 disinhibitory circuit is undetermined.

span.label: The experimenter could not be fully blinded.

span.label: The immunohistochemical estimate of VIP expression specificity and efficiency is not a gold-standard measure.
span.note: what this limits: the VIP expression specificity figures: IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY IS NOT CONSIDERED A GOLD STANDARD METHOD FOR ASSESSING GENE EXPRESSION, SINCE BOTH ITS SPECIFICITY AND SENSITIVITY DEPENDS ON EXTERNAL factors

span.label: the experimenter could not be fully blinded, because finding the effect was necessary to position the electrodes; disclosed with its mitigation

Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: immunohistochemistry, used to estimate the specificity of VIP labelling, is stated by the authors not to be a gold standard for gene expression

span.label: the exclusion thresholds were relaxed for VIP cells specifically, using light-evoked waveform correlation instead

span.label: analysis windows differed between the two recorded areas, chosen from the observed response latencies

span.label: datasets were pooled across layers and areas on the strength of null results rather than demonstrated equivalence

span.label: divisive gain modulation —contrasted-with→ baseline firing rate
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS MULTIPLICATIVE SCALING VERSUS ADDITIVE OFFSET. 'one-parameter gain modulation models (additive or multiplicative) fitted the light-induced changes in average tuning curves: THE INHIBITED POPULATION SHOWED DIVISIVE GAIN MODULATION, WHEREAS THE CHANGE IN DELAYED ACTIVATED NEURONS WAS CONSISTENT WITH AN ADDITIVE SHIFT OF THE BASELINE FIRING RATE.' Both populations change their firing under the same manipulation; they differ on WHICH PARAMETER OF THE TUNING CURVE moves, which is the distinction the one-parameter models were fitted to decide. Q-473. · strength of the relation: 1 — the two one-parameter models, and the two populations show different ones
